tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"kubectl apply -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: basic-app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.31.5
        ports:

EOF"}

tool_calls.arguments:

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: basic-app
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: app
  ports:
  - port: 80

EOF"}
